"in plain sight" is a song by American singer and songwriter Khalid, released on August 15, 2025. It was the first single on his fourth studio album, After the Sun Goes Down, which was released on October 10, 2025.

Khalid broke into the music scene with his 2016 hit “Location” and has been hitting the ground running ever since, collaborating with other hitmakers like Billie Eilish, Calvin Harris, Normani, and many more. Khalid rose to fame with his debut album American Teen and the song “Young Dumb & Broke” in 2017.

The single, “in plain sight,” is a catchy, upbeat pop track that aligns perfectly with his signature music style. The music video, directed by 91 Rules was released on the same day as the song. Two months later it has gathered over 2.9 million views.

About the release, Khalid says, “This chapter is about taking my power back, living in my truth, and being able to express myself freely. I’m excited for my fans to experience this new era with me, not just musically, but personally.”
